Fab: See Fabio, except you’d be wrong to think Fab isn’t an intelligent or thoughtful individual. And he’s more creative than he lets on.
Fabian: A flittering-nothing-fable of a character, who kind of wanders around aimlessly like a ghost with current-existence issues.
Fabio: Fabulous Fabio is a big guy with an Italian heritage and a big ego. He works out at the gym and he's proud of the result. And...ahh...yep.....he's proud of the result. (Do anything for you, though.)
Fabrizio: For such an 'out there', extravagant, Italian-Stallion kind of name, Fabrizio is remarkably calm and gentle. Like a wild horse that has been broken-in to the tune of 79%, only rarely does he threaten anyone, and if he does it's for a bloody good reason. True to form, only those who meet him behind closed doors will see the full swell of passion the man possesses. Great with kids, although he makes a more playful uncle than father.
Falk: Well, I guess we should be thankful his parents never called him Tea Strainer. Falk likes things to be done well and he likes it when people put in a good effort. It doesn't matter if things go to shit and you make a hell of a mess, so long as  you attempt to do whatever it is you're doing, well, then he'll give  you your due. Things can change quickly, Falk is all too well-aware of this, and so all he wants is for the best in this moment with the knowledge we have.
Farrell: Is he a lawyer? He probably should have been because he is a cocky shit. Rude to waiters.
Farren: Farren applies himself well and without the need for adulation….well, almost. His failures effect him deeply and he is a man of his word. He might even be a little bit shy.
Fatman: A rather replete individual who knows who he is, knows what he enjoys and makes no bones about the fact that his chubby cheeks are part of the deal. If he's lean of stature then Fatman is an uncompromising negotiator who won't take no for an answer.
Faz: The gifted madman. His artistic talents are weighed up against a set of deluded self-beliefs which include buying in to every conspiracy theory he comes across. At night he stares at the youtube for hours, until finally writing down all his spells and casting the pieces of paper into a cauldron, in the hope of single-handedly achieving the collapse of western civilisation. Beware!
Fazio: Fazio is a social butterfly that sticks to the pubs, clubs and cafes near the beach. He is a shit hot dancer and carries a permanent erection.
Fehin: Funny little fucker, isn’t he? He has an answer for everything, a joke for everyone and penny for the homeless. He just needs a good wash once in a while if he’s going to have any chance with the ladies.
Fence: Like a non-violent one-man A-team, if you need something fixed, get Fence. The End.
Fenn: A cross between a still Irish glen, an ancient Otway fern and a Tasmanian pig pen at feeding time, Fenn is both tranquil and ridiculous.
Fergus: His IQ score is in the top 0.5% of the population, which explains why he’s so fast with the perfect one-liner. Apart from being very funny, Fergus is one of the true sexual deviants.
Ferris: Sure, he's woken up on a strange floor a few times but he goes hard at the partying caper like he goes hard everywhere. He learns fast and is always busy, which is why Ferris succeeds at most things in life. As a definite ‘pants man’ he’s hard to pin down for a long-term loving commitment, but he’ll try anything once.
Fetch: A doer and provider of services and goods.
Fidel: Come on - do some work you lazy shit!
Finchy: The lone policeman in a small country town. Everyone knows his name and nearly everyone respects him as a decent bloke who is doing a good job by doing the best he can, while at the same time always giving people the benefit of the doubt.
Finian: Sure, he loves his Guiness but most of all he loves a small but loud gathering where music and laughter echo through to outside. He isn't the only person in the Kingdom to feel this way but he's one of the few that endeavours to cultivate such a setting as a regular hobby. Finian.
Finlay: Rarely deprived of the finer things, let alone a decent family upbringing, Finlay forges through life like a person swimming the breast-stroke, and who performs it quite well. Trouble is, if there is a rip or a shark nearby and he needs to swim quickly, his freestyle stroke is bloody awful which means he cant get anywhere in a hurry. Indeed, if he sticks his head in the water for too long he'll drown. But, so long as he keeps his chin above the surface and carefully watches the currents around him, and the shore, he'll do well. Finlay.
Finley: Yes, you guessed it, as a member of the Oxford 8, Finley has attitude and his parents probably have some cash, which can be nice. But disregarding that, Finley's role in the boat is one of comic relief. Sure, he aches and agonises just as much as anyone, but what's the point fucking complaining. Someone has to keep the spirits up, old boy, and here is the man for the job. Indeed, he doesn't take too much seriously, which, like most things, can be a blessing and a curse.
Finn: Having arrived at the last of his reincarnations, Finn is not far from the finish line and it makes sense then that he is a placid and ostensibly good individual. None of us are going to feel like having a full-on party at the end, anyway.
Finnegan: Finnegan wears a Devil's pentogram around his neck.
Finnigan: Finnegan may have a strange amulet around his neck, sure, but he certainly has a pudgy, nuggety little fishing boat. He catches very few fish and seems to spend most of his time painting it and sharing a smoke and a joke with some of the other fishermen in the boat yard who, like him, should try spending more time fishing and less time gas-bagging.
Finten: A calm individual who incapable of rushing. He is therefore a meticulous plate drier.
Finton: The trout fisherman who is both patient and peculiar.
Fionn: What a rather lovely and singular man. Fionn (pronounced Finn )operates from a very centred space most of the time and while he's not hyperactive, thank god, boys will be boys. His friends, like him, are interesting and considerate, and with regards to romance he enjoys spending a long time with one person, rather than leaving a trail of pining short-term hearts. As for a career, all we can say is that he has an artistic edge. He's no motor mechanic.
Fish: Completely unrelated to his female counterpart, Fish is extremely lucky and he’s English. He drinks hard, he plays harder and after he left the army he wound up working for a Sheik in Saudi Arabia. No one knows what he does, and he’d be hard pressed to explain it himself.
Fisk: Yeah, well, no surprises here kids. Fisk is a canny operator who has never been bored in his life. He sees through useless/un-giving people in an instant and they can expect never to encounter him again. He doesn't mind hard physical work but there must be a larger plan in the offing, and one that involves mental stimulation. As soon as his thinking brain is disengaged then the game is up. And, if he is (very occasionally) rude and/or manipulative it's only because he has grasped the situation before those around him. He's rarely broke, although he's very happy to declare bankruptcy over and over again if he needs to.
Flashy: Not as ballsy as you might think, Flashy is actually a picture of conservatism around the house and home. He plans well in business and he’s never deliberately ripped anyone off.
Flavio: Well, you can't deny his enthusiasm, can you. Batman, Ironman, Thor, The Green Lantern and, of course, the one he plans to pull out on his wedding night, Superman, are just some of the costumes he likes to bring into the bedroom for play behind closed doors. To be honest, they're the main reason that many of his girlfriends decided to stay with him for as long as they did.
Fleetwood:
Is Fleetwood a simpleton?
No.
Is he lazy?
He used to be.
Is he a musician?
Thankfully, no.
Does he work hard?
He’s matured with age, let’s just say that.
Is he tired of the references to the band?
Of course.
In summation, Fleetwood is over the hustle and the bustle of modern, city living. He wants to live the quiet life, maybe on some property with a good garden and a few animals to entertain his kids. This would be enough for Fleetwood.
Fletch: Fletch is so laid back that he hardly gets anything done. He is, however, arguably the calmest person in the Kingdom in that he never panics, ever, and the last breath of air that he takes before leaving this life will be used to tell some kind of joke.
Fletcher: Fletcher cuddles like a big furry Kodiak Bear.
Flint: The disappearing act. We’re sure he’s good fun but no one ever seems to know where he is.
Florian: Well-dressed in natural fibres, Florian has good hair and attracts the ladies. Question is, are they powerful, ridiculous, funny and memorable ladies? Either way, Florian hangs out near the art scene and various auction houses where he is always on the lookout for a bargain.
Floyd: The buffoon with good looks – albeit, a buffoon with a rousing sense of humour because, not only does he know he’s a buffoon, he actually goes out of his way to tell others he’s a buffoon.
Flynn: Girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls, girls (unless he's other way inclined), then sleep.
Fog: Fog is the sort of fellow who will take up a position as director of a scientific research station on a small tropical island. Not one to sit idle, Fog will use his post to (A) meet and bed as many female researchers as he can and (B) grow and sell crops of marijuana.
Ford: Don't give him blackness. Give him lights. Big, shiny disco lights with plenty of loud music and pretty girls. He ain't no mover and shaker but he's certainly a player.
Fox: In his own mind, his life peaked when he had his own roped-off section inside the VIP area, in one of London's classier second tier nightclubs. Anything else, Fox, or is that the sum of of your greatest achievements?...
Foxy: At some point in his life Foxy will exactly resemble the four-legged variety and much of that guile has carried over because he is a wonderful and enigmatic smart arse, who’ll only end up in the rubbish if his girlfriend kicks him out of the house for being drunk.
Foz: Always looking for shortcuts, Foz grew pot under his house for years until the cops came round in an unrelated matter. Foz was so used to his lifestyle by then he didn't think twice about answering the door with a joint in his hand. The rest is history. Now he's a priest.
Francesco: Naughty, not silly and more than just a tiny bit perverted, Francesco was once kicked out of high school for boring a hole through the wall of the girls' change rooms.
Francis: The Sicilian tomato farmer who migrated in the 60's and grew lots of white chest hair. His original name was Luigi but he changed it after he arrived so he would fit in, and he has one of the strongest handshake grips in the world. Don't even think about looking at his daughter.
Frank: One of the world’s generous men. Regardless of that, Frank can speak for quite a while without actually saying very much.
Frankie: Frankie is the name of the fellow who sells hotdogs out the front of the disco after it shuts. He loves pretty young girls and he loves hotdogs with onion, mustard and lots of tomato sauce, but get him drunk and you might see a different fellow, altogether – possibly a dangerous and crazy one.
Franklin: Franklin drifts off to sleep at night dreaming about the number of properties he’ll one day own.
Franz: Franz will prod and poke and nudge and bump you, until he's got you figured out.
Fraser: Whether he has a chip on his shoulder or not, Fraser has huge reserves of energy that compel him to live a busy life. And he’ll never back down from a fight, even if he is bleeding badly.
Frayne: Sociopath. A nice one, though. He won't bite.
Fred: Metaphorically, Fred is like a 1200 year old Huon pine resting undisturbed in a secluded section of the western Tasmanian wilderness. Some woodchoppers saw him once, years ago, and elected to leave him be and to this day he casts a loving eye over his beloved forest. He has survived generations of howling gales from the roaring forties and he never gets tired of celebrating his life by closing his eyes and swaying in a warm afternoon breeze. And what does all this mean for our young Fred? In human terms he is perpetually young, perpetually optimistic and he never gets too caught up in either the future or the past. Life is here, so why not be a little silly and try to live peacefully and happily in this moment. Thanks Fred.
Freddy: The name of the bloke that runs the meat tray raffle at the footy club every Saturday night.
Frederick: Frederick is a Swedish backpacker living some-where between Bondi Beach and Port Douglas, or the Greek islands or the California coast. He is just over 6 feet tall, has blonde eyebrows and is kind of skinny.
Freeman: Well I suppose he is, but I wonder if his staff feel the same way? Are they paid enough, sir? So come on, don’t be a tight arse. Management.
Friesland: A clean and methodical man whose pet is a rather temperamental Great Dane.
Frog: Frog is another all-round nice guy, and the most we can say about his capacity to save world is that he is here.
Fudgie: Fudgie has a super quick wit, but because the world expects him to come in second, or a second later than he could, he does. And so, bugger that idea Fudgie. Do it your way.
Fynn: I know, just relax. The crew up here in the box think you should head on over to Finn. Cheers.
